about.keyRegistration: Each case's key as an adapter registers it, in the shape accepted by usher-types' validateRegistration: its kind, resource field name and category conditions, and its resource list when it has one.
about.outcomes: served: the key narrows the catalogue and the record is within the narrowing, or the key allows every record. withheld: the key narrows the catalogue and the record is outside it. denied: the key refuses the catalogue outright, so no record is judged; a denial never counts as withheld.
about.principalId: The id of the principals.json entry supplying a case's payload.
about.purpose: Conformance expectations: what an application serves one principal through one key, record by record. With the payload in principals.json, each case holds everything needed to check it.
about.records: Each record judged: its values by field name, the key's resource field among them, its outcome, and the reason for it.
about.rule: A record carries every category whose condition it matches, and lacking a field read by a condition counts as matching it. It is served when the principal holds record view on its resource for each of its categories, or for global.unmarked when it carries none: permissions-model.md, The visibility rule.

records.reason: Its principal holds nothing, so the key denies the whole catalogue as no-grants and even an unmarked record is never judged.
VOID_INDEX is served and not held, since its unmarked records are by grant and nobody holds them, so a record on it is withheld even though it is unmarked.
Unmarked, and unmarked is held on HEART_STUDY, so withholding VOID_INDEX takes nothing from the studies held.
It carries both categories, and community-governed is not held on REEF_ARCHIVE: a record needs each of its categories held.
It carries controlled alone, which is held on REEF_ARCHIVE.
It carries community-governed, which is not held on REEF_ARCHIVE.
No condition matches open, so it carries no category: it is unmarked, and unmarked is held on REEF_ARCHIVE.
An empty category field reads as missing, so it counts as carrying both categories, community-governed among them.
An absent category field reads as missing, as an empty one does, so it counts as carrying both categories.
It carries controlled, which is held on REEF_ARCHIVE alone and not on HEART_STUDY.
No condition matches open, so it is unmarked, and unmarked is held on HEART_STUDY.
No condition expects restricted, so it carries no category and is served as unmarked, held on HEART_STUDY: only a catch-all condition in the key would withhold it.
It carries controlled, which is not held on HEART_STUDY, so a value expected by a condition is withheld where restricted is served.
